items.name: REKA
items.sub: Emberstorm Entertainment · Early Access, Building, Indie

items.name: ForgeTax
items.desc: A dark, first-person forging roguelite. Hammer swords into absurd fortunes, bend the odds with relics, and risk it all on your next strike. Spend precious blades to build powerful synergies. Meet the dragon's tribute—or face its wrath.

items.name: Scritchy Scratchy
items.desc: Scritchy Scratchy is a super-satisfying scratch card incremental game. Buy stacks of scratch-offs, unlock auto-scratching, and chase massive jackpots. Will you play it safe or go all-in?

items.name: Hades II
items.desc: Battle beyond the Underworld using dark sorcery to take on the Titan of Time in this bewitching sequel to the award-winning rogue-like dungeon crawler.

items.name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
items.desc: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis is a fantasy tower defense strategy game that takes you back in time to the early days of the Kingdom with bold new twists. Build towers, command heroes, and stop Vez’nan’s corruption before it tears the kingdom apart!

items.name: Go-Go Town!
items.sub: Prideful Sloth · Early Access, Simulation, City Builder
items.desc: Step into the role of a hands-on mayor and build your town from the ground up. Plan neighborhoods, automate logistics, and grow your community—all while juggling workers, infrastructure, and day-to-day chaos to create your dream town. Play solo for total control, or bring friends for co-op mayhem.

items.name: Master of Command
items.desc: Take command in Europe's greatest 18th-century war. Equip & customize regiments, manage supplies, and engage in brutal real-time battles across procedural campaigns. Resources and replacements are scarce, and keeping your best men alive may matter more than any single victory.

items.name: AI Olympius
items.sub: Lion's Shade · Third-Person Shooter, PvE, Shooter
items.desc: Join the rebels in a third-person shooter with RPG elements and base-building mode. Fight against various combat drone models under the control of the supreme AI.

items.name: Escape From Duckov
items.desc: Escape from Duckov is a PVE indie survival RPG — in a duck's world!. Scavenge for resources, build your hideout, and upgrade your gear in the world of Duckov. Start from nothing and rise to the top. Outwit hostile ducks, survive, or make it out alive.

items.name: Moon Sweepers
items.desc: An entire Moon to clean. One toothbrush to start. Team up with up to 16 players, collect and sell lunar dust, upgrade your tools, and unlock cleaning vehicles. Turn a ridiculous job into a thriving operation, if your friends actually help.

items.name: Outcast Tales
items.desc: A challenging post-apocalyptic roguelite turn-based RPG about the psychological stresses of adventuring with complete idiots. Lead a crew of flawed heroes against the consequences of their own terrible decisions. Can you keep your heroes together when everyone thinks they're in charge?

items.name: Checkmate: The Red General’s Last Move
items.desc: Checkmate is a turn-based Xiangqi roguelite where a lone red general carries a cannon into a 9×10 battlefield. Move to reload, fire risky snap shots, aim for precision, and use enemy pieces as firing screens. Each upgrade also strengthens the opposing army.

items.name: Mahjong Rush
items.desc: A single-player mahjong roguelike with an ink-wash art style. Make runs and sets from your tiles to score points — complete a winning hand and your score multiplies. Buy Flower cards, talismans and treasures to get stronger.. Never played mahjong? A step-by-step tutorial gets you started.

items.name: Operator: Observation
items.desc: Take on the role of Colin Nox, a security operator monitoring surveillance cameras for anomalies. What starts as a routine job quickly turns sinister as the anomalies grow more aggressive, invading the houses you watch, breaking into your home, and crawling into your mind.

items.name: Spook & Sell
items.sub: Crushed Olives Studios · Adventure, Casual, Strategy
items.desc: Stage the haunt. Sell the house. You’re the world’s most desperate real-estate agents — hide the ghosts, mop the ectoplasm, and keep buyers calm in this chaotic 1–4 player co-op physics party game before the haunting meter tips over.
